shortDescription: Retrieve zone information in Hosttech DNS service

options.name: hosttech_password
options.description: The password for the Hosttech API user. If provided, O(hosttech_username) must also be provided. Mutually exclusive with O(hosttech_token).

options.name: hosttech_token
options.description: The password for the Hosttech API user. Mutually exclusive with O(hosttech_username) and O(hosttech_password). Since community.dns 1.2.0, the alias O(ignore:api_token) can be used.

options.name: hosttech_username
options.description: The username for the Hosttech API user. If provided, O(hosttech_password) must also be provided. Mutually exclusive with O(hosttech_token).

options.name: zone_id
options.description: The ID of the DNS zone to query. Exactly one of O(zone_name) and O(zone_id) must be specified.

options.name: zone_name
options.description: The DNS zone to query. Exactly one of O(zone_name) and O(zone_id) must be specified.
